scope_limits: Public captures are sparse UI-clock samples, not all half-frame runtime sweeps.
Direct fixed-time probes verify actual production deformation at selected exact times, not selector reachability.
Historical nearest-rest source map is not used to claim current vertex identity.
UV/current-rest mesh lineage and material correctness are not proved by topology equality alone.
Raw v4 Liv/Yui automatic non-observation must be reconciled against real-time v5 timing test, not counted automatically as game failure.
